19566.ins: Seven spandex pieces means seven chances for a size mismatch, and spandex solves it the way it solves everything - stretch. Wash the set together on gentle so the red stays one red across all pieces, and skip the dryer to keep the stretch honest.
19566.short: Red spandex Lolita maid set with seven pieces from headdress to apron, one size for 40-60 kg, the fullest maid kit.

19665.ins: Pink polyester bunny-maid crossover in one coordinated purchase - the usual risk in crossover themes is piecing them together from separate listings, and this one arrives resolved. Cold wash, hang dry, and the pink holds its shade.
19665.short: Pink polyester bunny maid costume sold as a complete coordinated set, one size for 40-60 kg, two themes one purchase.

19727.ins: The concealed clasp is the detail that earns its name: it opens the front without any visible hardware giving the game away, and it lies flat enough to wear under clothing if the plan involves a reveal rather than a costume party.
19727.short: Sheer lace one-piece with concealed front clasp in black or white, one size for 40-60 kg, bikini-cut lingerie with hidden opening.

19731.ins: The three-size run on a patent leather suit is rare enough to be the headline - the material punishes a wrong fit harder than any fabric, and 5 kg bands give the chart real resolution. Wipe after wear; hang away from heat between seasons.
19731.short: Black patent leather bunny suit with rabbit ears and bracelet in three exact sizes S to L, 40-60 kg in 5 kg bands.

19733.ins: Gold velvet runs warm - a winter bunny set by intention rather than accident. The sheen shifts gold under tungsten and softer under daylight, worth knowing before a photoshoot picks its lighting. Six pieces is every accessory slot filled.
19733.short: Gold velvet bunny set with six pieces including headband, bra, thong and leg ring, in red, black or pink for 40-60 kg.

19760.ins: The cutouts are knitted in, so the edges will not fray no matter how often the sweater goes through the wash. Gray is the colorway that reads streetwear rather than costume, which is why this piece crosses over where the others do not.
19760.short: Gray knitted turtleneck sweater with openwork cutouts knitted in, one size for 40-60 kg, costume-to-streetwear crossover.

19799.ins: Patent leather with printed measurements is a rare courtesy - the 80 cm bust and 72 cm waist figures let you check before ordering rather than discovering the fit after. Wipe clean, store hanging, and the belt keeps the silhouette honest through wear.
19799.short: Sheer patent leather nurse set with hat, belt and thong in three colors, one size with printed 80 cm bust fit, 40-65 kg.

19804.ins: The strapping across the open chest is structural as well as decorative - it is what keeps the sweater on, replacing the shoulder fabric it removes. Machine wash cold in a bag; the openwork survives the cycle where woven trim would not.
19804.short: Polyester openwork sweater with open-chest strap design and matching short skirt, one size for 40-60 kg, two-piece set.

19837.ins: The garter belt does double duty: it breaks the jumpsuit line at the hip and holds stockings if the outfit wants them - the belt is the reason this five-piece set outlasts the basic bunny kits in a wardrobe. Red or black, same construction.
19837.short: Five-piece polyester bunny set with headband, jumpsuit, bow tie, bracelet and garter belt in red or black, bust 70-110 cm.

19853.ins: Seven coordinated pieces close the usual cat-maid gap: the apron says maid while the ears say cat, and nothing needs sourcing to bridge them. Polyester washes gentle and dries fast - the thong and bracelets want a bag to themselves.
19853.short: Seven-piece cat girl maid set with apron and headband in black or pink polyester, one size for 40-60 kg, coordinated crossover.
